leah (partnerops): ping — NimbusHW just pushed an hourly dump where about ~70 events used local timestamps without utc_reported_at and some event_id fields are blank. previews show duplicate lines for 10 customers.

omar (eng): can you paste a tiny redacted sample?

leah (partnerops): paste: ```json
{"customer_id":"nimbus-7","units":50,"reported_at_local":"2026-04-02T01:05:00-07:00","event_id":""}
{"customer_id":"nimbus-7","units":50,"utc_reported_at":"2026-04-02T08:05:00Z","event_id":"evt-42"}
```

nina (payments): blank event_id prevents dedupe; mismatched timestamps cause duplicate previews. if we backfill wrong we could credit incorrectly.

omar (eng): immediate plan: 1) pause NimbusHW's hourly feed (low blast radius); 2) ask partner to resend with utc_reported_at + event_id populated; 3) add an ingest-side canonicalizer that infers UTC from reported_at_local and writes inferred_utc, and treat empty event_id as "needs_partner_fix" so we don't auto-dedupe.

raju (marketplace): prefer partner-resend + strict schema. we can enable a 24h soft-accept window for legacy partners where we accept inferred_utc but flag for ops.

leah (partnerops): i've asked NimbusHW for a cleaned resend (ETA 70m). pausing now.

ingest-bot: action scheduled: pause-ingest nimbushw by leah at 2026-04-02T09:12:00Z

omar (eng): i'll ship a tiny validation change to return 400 for missing event_id in new partner profiles and telemetry for inferred_utc occurrences. will coordinate a short RFC for partner_profiles conversion flags.

nina (payments): i'll watch previews and prepare credits playbook if any invoice preview delta > $15 after backfill.

leah (partnerops): owners: omar (ingest fix + RFC), nina (billing verify), raju (policy), leah (partner comms). closing loop once resend lands. :thumbsup:
